```{r question 1}

base_url <- "https://www.miamioh.edu/fsb/academics/"

dept_urls <- c(
  "Accountancy"      = paste0(base_url, "accountancy/about/faculty-staff/index.html"),
  "Economics"        = paste0(base_url, "economics/about/faculty-staff/index.html"),
  "Entrepreneurship" = paste0(base_url, "entrepreneurship/about/faculty-staff/index.html"),
  "Finance"          = paste0(base_url, "finance/about/faculty-staff/index.html"),
  "Information Systems & Analytics" =
    "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics/all",
  "Marketing"        = paste0(base_url, "marketing/about/faculty-staff/index.html"),
  "Management"       = paste0(base_url, "management/about/faculty-staff/index.html")
)

scrape_dept <- function(url, dept) {
  Sys.sleep(1)

  rows  <- rvest::read_html(url) |> rvest::html_elements("table tr")
  links <- rvest::html_element(rows, "strong a")

  tibble::tibble(
    department = dept,
    name       = links |> rvest::html_text2() |> stringr::str_squish(),
    position   = rvest::html_element(rows, "i") |> rvest::html_text2() |> stringr::str_squish(),
    website    = rvest::html_attr(links, "href")
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name))
}

fsb_directory <- purrr::map2(dept_urls, names(dept_urls), scrape_dept) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

head(fsb_directory)
```
